categories.name: Big Points
categories.sourceName: Big Points -- Game-winning Goals + Overtime Assists + Shootout Goals + Shorthanded Points + Hat Tricks

categories.name: Hat Tricks
categories.sourceName: Hat Tricks -- Three or more goals in a game

categories.name: Blocks
categories.sourceName: Blocks -- A player blocks a shot by an opposing shooter.

categories.name: Games Started
categories.sourceName: Games Started -- Number of times a Goalie has started the game.

categories.name: Goalie Wins
categories.sourceName: Wins (Goalies only) -- Includes Overtime Wins and Shootout Wins. Skaters cannot get a win using this category - for that - use the "regular" Wins category.

categories.name: Losses
categories.sourceName: Losses -- Includes only regulation losses in the NHL regular season, but also overtime losses in the NHL playoffs.

categories.name: Overtime Wins
categories.sourceName: Overtime Wins -- A win in overtime. Does not include Shootout Wins.
